notes: Seeded from the FastCover standing growth dashboard (index.html) so curated answers reconcile with the report. Revenue and ROAS are FastCover's directional in-platform lens, not audited business revenue (policy fourteen10-fastcover-in-platform-revenue-lens-directional). The blended rollup excludes Bing; the age source includes it.

blended.label: All Channels (blended)
blended.notes: Cross-platform daily rollup. Excludes Bing. Revenue is directional in-platform.

meta.label: Meta
meta.notes: Standing dashboard reports spend, purchases, CPA and quotes. Purchase revenue exists in the warehouse but is heavily view-through and is not surfaced as a standing metric.

tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.notes: Revenue is not populated for TikTok in the standing dashboard; CPA only.

ga4_transactions.label: GA4 Transactions
ga4_transactions.notes: Transactions come from the events table filtered to event_name='transactions'. This default filter is always applied.

age.label: Age performance
age.notes: Detailed age performance. Groups by the governed `age_band` (classified once in dataform via the shared age-band grid), or by raw `age`, platform, or gender. Same age_band definition as rollup_age_daily, so numbers reconcile; this detailed mart additionally allows age-by-platform and age-by-gender. Gender is not yet normalised in the marts (mixed case/variants), so it is not a curated dimension yet; it remains reachable via the guarded fallback and should get the same dataform treatment as age_band.
